cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Pulled Away First
cards.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before your taxi comes, let's restart our letters. I've brought paper and stamps; we'll get the correspondence running properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You never answered my last three.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Postal delays. We'll remove that variable: write the first letters here and exchange them before you leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I handed you the last one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay while I write this reply. Date at the top, signature at the end, straight into your hand. Please don't leave with another blank page.

reason: Make professional correspondence and delivery procedure the urgent repair tactic while A avoids admitting the personal failure B exposes.
